title: The Plug
text: The shaft head is a ring of black metal set flush in the ice, ten metres across. The shaft below it has been filled: water poured in and left to freeze, a plug thirty metres deep. The pad round it is our make in every bolt. Somebody drilled here, then wanted it closed.

choices.label: Drill
choices.reply: The drones set up over the plug and start cutting. The ice sings. Out on the ring, every walker stops and turns.

effects.text: Drilling the plug: hold the shaft head

notes: Starts the drill countdown (150 s). flag drilling brings the drawn walkers (encounter drill-drawn).
